admission.read: dev queries only; no test query was ranked

amendment.change: exclude Wikidata properties (P ids) from both Wikidata lanes; keep only items (Q ids)
amendment.consequence: this is not a fresh preregistered test: the test split was read once. The pass rule, arms, seeds and splits are unchanged; models are retrained from scratch under models/e0b_a1
amendment.found: after the first test run was read (a check of entity kinds, not of scores)
amendment.why: properties such as 'Boomplay ID' are not things located anywhere; 10 (ng) and 7 (wa) entered via the country filter

arms: fine_tuned:seed0..2 (base intfloat/multilingual-e5-small, prefix 'query: ', TrainConfig defaults, epochs 2, hard negatives: up to 5 TF-IDF top-50 neighbours of dev entities)

wikidata_ng.note: 4000 of 9782 multi-name entities, <= 8 names each, salted-hash sample

wikidata_wa.note: 4000 of 19964 multi-name entities, <= 8 names each, salted-hash sample

data.excluded: people (P31 = Q5): name variants of persons are identity data and are not needed here

decision: per lane; a lane passes only if every check in the rule holds. No pooled verdict.
known_ceiling: Some aliases are not derivable from the name at all (e.g. Nigerian electoral codes such as 'SC/708/NG' for a senatorial or state constituency, abbreviations). They lower every arm's ceiling equally and stay in the lane.
question: Does intfloat/multilingual-e5-small, fine-tuned on a lane's development entities, find true pairs that character 3-gram TF-IDF misses, on lanes where TF-IDF leaves room?

sampling.rule: entities with >= 2 distinct names (casefold, whitespace-collapsed), ordered by sha256('e0b-sample\0'+lane+'\0'+qid); names within an entity ordered by sha256('e0b-sample\0'+lane+'\0'+qid+'\0'+name)

splits.rule: dev if int(sha256(lane + '\0' + entity)[:8], 16) % 2 == 0 else test
splits.unit: entity (Wikidata QID); every name of one item is in one split

why_e0b: E0 failed all four lanes because TF-IDF recall@10 was already 0.976-1.000 on test; a 2-point gain was unreachable. Lanes were chosen without a headroom check. E0b admits lanes on dev headroom only.
